newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca squeezed higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca squeezed higher in late trading.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc were squeezed to a record high late on Friday amid a resurgence of the usual batch of vague takeover rumours, dealers said.
"No-one wants to sell and there are some panicky bears trying to get back into the stock," said dealer. "No-one wants to be short ahead of the weekend."
The stock was up 67p at 18.84-1/2 by 1613 GMT in volume of 3.6 million shares, after earlier touching a record 18.90 stg -- surpassing the previous peak of 18.20 stg yesterday.

Shares in Zeneca have been subject to frequent bouts of bid speculation for many months as the global drug industry consolidates. The stock can be particularly volatile at times of thin trading when there is a lack of liquidity in the market.

Market-makers said no specific names had today been mentioned as possible bidders or merger partners for Zeneca. Speculation in the past has included a range of U.S. and Swiss drug companies such as Roche Holding AG.
By the close Zeneca shares were up 77-1/2p at 18.95 stg. No-one at the company was immediately available to comment.
